themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI systems that can act autonomously to conduct research tasks, including analysis, data gathering, and hypothesis generation.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that help developers write, debug, and optimize code, acting as a co-pilot in the coding process.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad range of AI-powered platforms and tools specifically designed to aid researchers in various stages of their work, from literature review to data analysis.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles detailing AI applications for condensing large amounts of text into concise summaries, useful for research papers, meetings, and general information processing.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Explores how AI is being integrated into product development workflows, from ideation and feature prioritization to roadmap planning and analysis.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Focuses on AI's role in informing and enhancing the design process, including user interface generation, prototyping, and design system integration.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Covers the use of AI to generate simulated users or user behaviors for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that compare the capabilities, performance, or pricing of different AI tools for research and development.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is affecting jobs, employment, and the skills required in the workforce, including job displacement and new role creation.

themes.name: AI content generation
themes.description: Focuses on AI's ability to create various forms of content, such as text, images, and code, for research and design applications.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
